sourceName: Mundus country boundary view (Natural Earth Admin 0), land parts and shared borders
version: Natural Earth 5.1.2, Mundus boundary view, high detail
transformations: Split every high-detail Mundus country unit into its separate land parts and number them by spherical area, largest first
Join parts of different units that share a TopoJSON boundary arc; a shared point alone is not a border
Drop one reviewed water-only boundary: DR Congo–Tanzania, which runs only through Lake Tanganyika
Add two reviewed land borders the simplified geometry loses: China–Macao (Barrier Gate) and Botswana–Zambia (Kazungula, about 150 m)
List seven reviewed bridges and tunnels that join separate landmasses (Channel Tunnel, Øresund, Great Belt, Little Belt, Bosphorus, Johor–Singapore Causeway, King Fahd Causeway); no ferries
Keep only parts with at least one border or fixed link; units without one have no land route
missingValuePolicy: A unit absent from the asset has no land border and no fixed link. Units missing from the low-detail globe are still part of every route.
boundaryPolicy: Mundus draws boundaries from the Natural Earth China point of view, except that Taiwan is shown as its own unit. Borders follow that view and are not a legal authority on territorial status or on whether a crossing is open.
